# Error Functions

![Error Functions function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/error-functions/00_R%C3%A9pertoire%20Error%20Functions.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Seven mathematical special functions: Erf, ErfC, Scaled ErfC, Inverse Erf, Inverse ErfC, Fresnel and Dawson. ni_documented_real_v1 uses q=abs(x); standard_real_v1 is the signed mathematical kernel. These nodes use real numeric data. NI runtime parity and graphical NXG signatures have not been measured.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

Sept fonctions mathématiques spéciales : Erf, ErfC, ErfC échelonnée, Erf inverse, ErfC inverse, Fresnel et Dawson. ni_documented_real_v1 utilise q=abs(x) ; standard_real_v1 est le noyau mathématique signé. Données numériques réelles. Parité NI et connecteurs NXG non mesurés.

</details>

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Erf](../../math/special/error_functions/erf.md) | Computes the Gaussian error function erf(q). erf(1)=0.8427007929497149. Required x:f64, no default. ni_documented_real_v1 uses q=abs(x), never abs(result); the separate standard_real_v1 kernel uses signed x. NI-G documentation, not measured NI/NXG parity. See Detailed Help for domains, limits and FROG extensions. |
| [ErfC](../../math/special/error_functions/erfc.md) | Computes the complementary error function erfc(q). erfc(8) and erfc(27) retain nonzero representable tails. Required x:f64, no default. ni_documented_real_v1 uses q=abs(x), never abs(result); the separate standard_real_v1 kernel uses signed x. NI-G documentation, not measured NI/NXG parity. See Detailed Help for domains, limits and FROG extensions. |
| [Scaled ErfC](../../math/special/error_functions/erfcx.md) | Computes the scaled complement erfcx(q)=exp(q*q)*erfc(q) stably. erfcx(30)=0.0187958888614168. Required x:f64, no default. ni_documented_real_v1 uses q=abs(x), never abs(result); the separate standard_real_v1 kernel uses signed x. NI-G documentation, not measured NI/NXG parity. See Detailed Help for domains, limits and FROG extensions. |
| [Inverse Erf](../../math/special/error_functions/erfinv.md) | Solves erf(y)=q, not 1/erf(q). Finite for q&lt;1; q=1 gives +Infinity; q&gt;1 gives NaN/domain. Required x:f64, no default. ni_documented_real_v1 uses q=abs(x), never abs(result); the separate standard_real_v1 kernel uses signed x. NI-G documentation, not measured NI/NXG parity. See Detailed Help for domains, limits and FROG extensions. |
| [Inverse ErfC](../../math/special/error_functions/erfcinv.md) | Solves erfc(y)=q, not 1/erfc(q). Domain 0&lt;=q&lt;=2, signed infinities at the ends. q=1.5 gives -0.4769362762044699. The original SVG formula omits c; this is inverse ErfC. Required x:f64, no default. ni_documented_real_v1 uses q=abs(x), never abs(result); the separate standard_real_v1 kernel uses signed x. NI-G documentation, not measured NI/NXG parity. See Detailed Help for domains, limits and FROG extensions. |
| [Fresnel](../../math/special/error_functions/fresnel.md) | Computes normalized integrals of cos(pi*t*t/2) and sin(pi*t*t/2). Two outputs: cosine_integral C(x) above sine_integral S(x). C(1)=0.7798934003768228; S(1)=0.4382591473903548. Required x:f64, no default. ni_documented_real_v1 uses q=abs(x), never abs(result); the separate standard_real_v1 kernel uses signed x. NI-G documentation, not measured NI/NXG parity. See Detailed Help for domains, limits and FROG extensions. |
| [Dawson](../../math/special/error_functions/dawson.md) | Computes Dawson D(q)=exp(-q*q)*integral(0,q,exp(t*t),dt). D(1)=0.5380795069127684. Required x:f64, no default. ni_documented_real_v1 uses q=abs(x), never abs(result); the separate standard_real_v1 kernel uses signed x. NI-G documentation, not measured NI/NXG parity. See Detailed Help for domains, limits and FROG extensions. |
